author: Cinna Davis, with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance
statement: The bipartite hypercube system has exact count 3^(2^d) for odd d; its fixed branches admit poly(m)2^b time for odd d and poly(m)2^(m/2) for even d. The even-d image is self-dual, yielding exact count congruences.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the all-size argument
Determine whether even d has a simpler count or faster branch restrictions
